cycle_note: The P3 content-feel push plus roadmap staples. Top votes when the owner cuts the cycle decide what ships next.

candidates.title: World identity
candidates.blurb: Give the sector a visible identity: named regions, signage and a coherent look for every place you dock.

candidates.title: Contracts board
candidates.blurb: A station board where jobs are posted, compared and accepted.

candidates.title: Bosses, arenas, insurance, vaults
candidates.blurb: Boss fights, arena events and the insurance and vault services that make risky runs worth it.

candidates.title: Catalog breadth and shipyard
candidates.blurb: A wider module catalog and a proper shipyard to spend your credits at.

candidates.title: Galactic map travel
candidates.blurb: Jump between systems on a galactic map instead of flying out of a single hub.

candidates.title: Factions and standing
candidates.blurb: Factions with reputation, rewards and consequences for who you side with.

candidates.title: Heat and bounty
candidates.blurb: Heat for your crimes, wanted status, and bounty hunting to profit from other pilots' mistakes.

candidates.title: Crafting
candidates.blurb: Build your own modules from components and minerals instead of waiting for drops.

candidates.title: Refinery
candidates.blurb: Refine raw ore into the materials the rest of the economy runs on.

candidates.title: Player exchange
candidates.blurb: A market where pilots set the prices for loot, minerals and modules.
